Shift reminder for families
Someone on the desk wanted you to know
Travelers with pets need to check their travel papers and crate setup before arrival.
Pet travel notice

We are sorry for any confusion today, and we want to keep things simple for you. <<FACT F068>> Please bring your pet's health paperwork and keep it easy to review at the desk.

Our team reviews each case with care so the trip feels calmer for animals and people alike. <<FACT F079>> We note any service changes in the desk ledger and adjust plans when we can. If your pet is nervous, tell us early so we can help with a steadier hand.

Please stop by the Companion Animal Travel Desk for the latest guidance before you head to the gate.
Companion Animal Travel Desk
